# Project Brief — SYN (synthetic fixture)

## 1. Overview

### 1.1 Identity and Value

- A claims portal lets policyholders file and track insurance claims. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]

### 1.3 Success Metrics / Scope

- Claims filed online reach 60 percent within two quarters. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]

### 1.5 Release Acceptance Criteria

- A policyholder files a claim and sees it registered. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]
- An adjuster approves a claim and the policyholder sees the decision. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]

## 2. Business Lens

### 2.1 Actors and Goals by Role

- Policyholders file claims. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]
- Back office adjusters review and approve claims. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]

## 3. Product Lens

### 3.2 To-Be Process

- The policyholder files a claim with attachments. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]
- The adjuster approves or rejects the claim. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]

## 4. Design Lens

### 4.1 Screen Flow

- The claim form screen P-1 collects the incident data. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]

## 5. Technical Lens

### 5.1 Architecture and Integrations

- Every module uses a shared authorization filter. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]

### 5.6 Integration Map

- The payment provider pays approved claims. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]

## 6. Release Agreements

### 6.1 In Scope

- Online claim filing. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]
- Claim approval by adjusters. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]
- Payment of approved claims. [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]]

## 9. Things to Build

### 9.1 Build List or Phases

- `C-01` Claim filing [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]] — depends on: none
- `C-02` Claim approval [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]] — depends on: none
- `C-03` Claim payment [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]] — depends on: none
- `C-04` Claim status tracking [[sources § Source log - SYN # F-01 — supports: x]] — depends on: none
